title: aconitum × paniculatum var. rostratum
intro: Aconitum × paniculatum var. rostratum, commonly known as Japanese Monk's Hood or Japanese Aconitum, is a variety of flowering plant in the Aconitum genus. This plant has been used in traditional medicine for its potential health benefits, which include anti-inflammatory, antimicrobial, and antiviral properties. The therapeutic actions of Aconitum × paniculatum var. rostratum include analgesia, sedation, and vasodilation, attributed to its bioactive constituents, which include alkaloids, glycosides, and phenolic compounds. The main bioactive constituents of this plant are aconitine, mesaconitine, and hypaconitine, which are responsible for its medicinal properties.
